title: Science & Technology Essentials
notes:
Everyday Science

  • Speed of light: ~299,792 km/s (fastest known).
  • Speed of sound in air: ~343 m/s at 20°C.
  • pH scale: 0–14; 7 = neutral; < 7 acidic, > 7 basic.
  • Human body: 206 bones, 639 muscles; largest organ is skin; ~70% water by mass.
  • DNA: discovered structure by Watson & Crick (1953); units called nucleotides.
  • Planets: 8 in the solar system; the largest is Jupiter; the hottest is Venus.
  • Ozone layer: absorbs harmful UV radiation in the stratosphere.
  • Artificial Intelligence (AI): machines mimicking human cognition; large language models (LLMs) power modern chatbots.
